question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Get the top 3 combined points with constructor names
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
best_drivers AS (
  SELECT year, constructor_id, constructor_ref, driver_id, driver_ref
  FROM team_driver_ranks
  WHERE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
),
driver_season_points AS (
  SELECT lr.year, dr.driver_id, dr.driver_ref, dr.constructor_id, dr.constructor_ref,
         ds.points as driver_points
  FROM best_drivers dr
  JOIN last_races lr ON dr.year = lr.year
  JOIN driver_standings ds ON lr.last_race_id = ds.race_id AND dr.driver_id = ds.driver_id
),
constructor_season_points AS (
  SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, c.constructor_ref as cs_constructor_ref, cs.points as constructor_points
  FROM last_races lr
  JOIN constructor_standings cs ON lr.last_race_id = cs.race_id
  JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dsp.year, dsp.constructor_ref, dsp.driver_ref, csp.constructor_name,
         dsp.driver_points, csp.constructor_points,
         dsp.driver_points + csp.constructor_points as combined_points
  FROM driver_season_points dsp
  JOIN constructor_season_points csp ON dsp.year = csp.year AND dsp.constructor_id = csp.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, driver_ref, driver_points, constructor_points, combined_points
FROM combined
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
